decisions.reason: Grounds the two projections in host-input-contract.ts and host-input-facade.ts: draft/clipboardText/Occurrence offsets are clipboard coordinates while insertReference and consumeToken splice detectText where a chip is one U+FFFC, and plain text and separator spaces contribute normal width in both.

Points at snapshot.draft.length in plugin-client.js add, shows paste #1's 29-char clipboard offset overshoots the 2-char detect text so insertReference returns false and the plugin raises its changed-composer toast, explains the empty-composer coincidence and per-chip divergence of 27, and correctly rejects a real concurrent edit and the rev-CAS as the cause.

Traces remove passing occurrence.offset/length (0..28) unconverted to consumeToken, its ignored false result, the unconditional records.delete and changed(), the orphaned occurrence rendering as unavailable via records.get, and ties both lingering chips to the same coordinate mismatch rather than an upload failure.

Derives toDetect(c) = c − Σ(length−1) over preceding occurrences, applies it at both call sites (insert at draft end uses all preceding chips; removal maps occurrence.offset and uses a one-detect-character span), keeps the draftRev guard, and retires records only after a confirmed successful consumption or checked fallback.

Proposes two successive pastes asserting both chips/occurrences, then removal of a chip with another preceding chip asserting composer chip, dock chip and record go together while the other chip survives, plus valid extras (failed-consumption bookkeeping, last-chip and empty-again variants, Nth paste).
